findings.title: CATALOG_VARIANT_COUNT integer-collision pattern across Strategy-C cascade — 3-recurrence in single-phase
evidence: Phase-4-Meta-Core CATALOG conflicts: (1) PR #1324 G-CORE-3b 'REBASED past #1323' (2) PR #1339 commit `aa5d151f` 'merge: main into #1339 — resolve CATALOG conflict to 189' (3) PR #1341 commit `cf0894c5` 'merge: main into #1341 — resolve CATALOG conflict to 190'.
Each conflict required a manual merge commit + a CATALOG re-count + a CI re-run. ~3 sequential cycles (~35 min each) on those 3 PRs.
Each was caught + resolved correctly per HARD RULE 12 — but the recurrence pattern is real.
Root cause: `crates/benten-errors/tests/stable_shape.rs:CATALOG_VARIANT_COUNT` is a single literal integer that 2+ PRs touching ErrorCode in parallel collide on.

Mitigation candidate: extend §3.5g item 1 (ErrorCode catalog 4-surface) with a sub-rule mandating Strategy-C batching whenever ≥2 ErrorCode-touching PRs are open — the conflict is mechanically guaranteed; sequential merge is wasted CI.
findings.rule_basis: §3.5g item 1 ErrorCode catalog 4-surface + §3.14 Strategy-C batch-merge + foundational memory `feedback_strategy_c_batch_mandatory_not_optional`
findings.disposition: BELONGS-NAMED-NOW per HARD RULE 12 clause-(b) — named destination is a §3.5g item 1 sub-clause amendment: 'when ≥2 PRs touching ErrorCode are open simultaneously, Strategy-C batching is MANDATORY not optional (a corollary of `feedback_strategy_c_batch_mandatory_not_optional` extended to the ErrorCode collision class). Sequential merge of N ErrorCode-touching PRs costs N CATALOG-conflict-resolution cycles; batching collapses to 1.' Land at R6-FP-1 alongside the other §3.5g amendments.
findings.remediation: Add sub-clause to §3.5g item 1: 'CATALOG-collision Strategy-C trigger: when ≥2 PRs each touching CATALOG_VARIANT_COUNT are open, batch them via §3.14 Strategy-C before either merges. Sequential merge wastes one CI cycle per PR past the first.'

findings.title: §3.5g item-6 amendment baseline drain-to-zero contract has no specific deadline
evidence: PR #1342 commit `add82b09` shipped `scripts/drift-detect-error-variant-mirror.ts` (~620 LOC TS) enforcing §3.5g item 6 (pub error variant first-class mirror).

HARD RULE 12 clause-(b) requires 'BELONGS-NAMED-NOW-with-specific-destination + the destination receives the entry NOW'. The baseline file does receive the entries NOW; what's missing is the SCHEDULE for drain.
Without a schedule, the baseline becomes a permanent debt floor — exactly what §3.6h 'rule-ratification-against-drift mandatory-close' rules out.
findings.rule_basis: §3.5g item 6 + §3.6h Rule-ratification-against-drift mandatory-close clause + HARD RULE 12 clause-(b)

Sub-buckets: (1) crates/benten-core: <N> mirrors due Phase-4-Meta-Composing wave-X; (2) crates/benten-graph: <M> mirrors due Phase-4-Meta-Composing wave-Y; etc. Each bucket land as a named row in docs/future/phase-4-backlog.md.'
